title: Shelly Devices Configuration
description: JSON schema for Shelly device configuration used by shelly_rpc_mqtt.py.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: Unique identifier for the Shelly device used in MQTT topics and home assistant device IDs.

name.title: Display name
name.description: Display name for the Shelly device in Home Assistant.

host.title: Host
host.description: IP address or hostname of the Shelly device.

generation.title: Generation
generation.description: Shelly generation: 1 for Gen1 devices (/status) and 2 for Gen2+/RPC devices.

switch_channels.title: Switch channels
switch_channels.description: Number of relay channels available on the device.

has_power.title: Power measurements
has_power.description: Whether the device reports instantaneous power measurements.

has_energy.title: Energy measurements
has_energy.description: Whether the device reports energy measurements.

has_3phase.title: Three-phase measurements
has_3phase.description: True for Shelly 3EM devices with three-phase measurements.

adc_channels.title: ADC channels
adc_channels.description: Number of ADC channels available on the device.

has_humidity.title: Humidity measurements
has_humidity.description: Whether the device reports relative humidity (e.g. Shelly Plus H&T).

auth_user.title: Auth username
auth_user.description: Optional HTTP basic auth username for the Shelly device.

auth_password.title: Auth password
auth_password.description: Optional HTTP basic auth password for the Shelly device.
